data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element. This design system primarily uses borders and subtle background color changes rather than box-shadows for elevation.

levels.name: Small Focus Shadow
levels.description: Subtle focus indicator shadow used on interactive elements. Applied via utility class for accessibility focus states.

levels.name: Cookie Banner Shadow
levels.description: Small shadow applied to the fixed cookie policy banner for elevation above page content.
